summary: A Nam Jap (chanting counter) application with animation, persistent count saving, and support for multiple names including Radha Nam and Jai Shree Ram.
known_issues: Nam Jap count is not being saved (neither temporarily nor permanently)
Nam Jap section is missing Radha Nam and Jai Shree Ram name options

existing_features.title: Add Radha Nam (राधा नाम) and Jai Shree Ram (जय श्री राम) as selectable mantra/name options in the Nam Jap (Jap.tsx) page, alongside existing options. Each option must be selectable and update the Jap counter context accordingly.

Fix the Nam Jap count persistence so that: (a) the count is saved to localStorage for session/temporary persistence so it survives page refreshes, and (b) for authenticated users the count is synced and saved to the backend canister for permanent persistence. On page load, restore the count from backend (if authenticated) or localStorage (if guest).

Add meaningful animations to the Nam Jap (Jap.tsx) section. This should include: a smooth ripple or glow pulse effect on the main tap/count button each time it is pressed, a subtle entrance animation for the mala bead ring and counter display when the page loads, and a celebratory animation (e.g., divine light burst or petal shower) when a full mala (108 counts) is completed.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add animation to Nam Jap section
Fix Nam Jap count saving - both temporary (session) and permanent (persistent) storage
Add Radha Nam and Jai Shree Ram options to Nam Jap name selection
